gizmo.title: Uhlalutyo lokufundwayo
gizmo.description: Abafundi babeka iiflegi kwizivakalisi, imihlathi okanye imifanekiso ekufundwayo engubungqina belebheli nganye, okanye bakhethe isicatshulwa esiphendula umbuzo ngokona kulungileyo.

configure.title: Umbuzo
configure.description: Oko abafundi bacelwa ukuba bakufumane ekufundwayo.

configure.title: Umsebenzi
configure.description: Phawula ubungqina: abafundi babeka iflegi nganye ecaleni kobungqina bayo. Khetha enye: abafundi bakhetha isicatshulwa esinye esiphendula umbuzo ngokona kulungileyo.

configure.title: Abafundi bakhetha
configure.description: Oko umfundi akwalathayo ekufundwayo. Imifanekiso inokukhethwa ngalo lonke ixesha.

configure.title: Iiflegi
configure.description: Iilebheli ezibekwa ngabafundi. Sebenzisa u-Phawula iimpendulo kwimenyu yebhloko ukukhetha apho nganye ifanele khona.

configure.title: Okufundwayo
configure.description: Okufundwayo abasebenza kuko abafundi. Nayiphi na i-HTML: izihloko, imihlathi, uluhlu kunye nemifanekiso.

configure.title: Ifomathi yokumakisha
configure.description: OER Schema: ifomathi yokumakisha yolu vavanyo (umz. amanqaku, unobumba, ipesenti, ukugqitywa).

configure.title: Injongo yokufunda
configure.description: OER Schema: injongo yokufunda enxulumene nolu vavanyo.

configure.title: Ikhosi
configure.description: OER Schema: ikhosi olu vavanyo lwenzelwe yona.

advanced.title: Imizamo
advanced.description: Kangaphi umfundi anokujonga. U-0 uthetha ukuba akukho mda.

advanced.title: Iyagobeka
advanced.description: Bonisa lo mbuzo njengomqolo ovulekayo uvalwe. Ukuvula omnye kuvala eminye imibuzo egobekayo ekufutshane.

advanced.title: Qala igoqiwe
advanced.description: Xa igobeka, qala njengomqolo ovaliweyo obonisa umbuzo kuphela kunye nesimo sawo.

developer.title: Igama lekwizi
developer.description: Igama lekwizi elidluliselwa kwiindawo eziqhutywa yi-xAPI ukuze kuchongwe le nto
